name: dchub
description: Live data-center, power-grid, fiber, gas & M&A intelligence for AI agents — 82 tools over 19,300+ facilities, 300+ DCPI markets, real-time ISO grid telemetry, 1,900+ tracked deals. Query and cite (CC-BY-4.0).
long_description: DC Hub is the live infrastructure data layer for AI agents. This extension connects Claude Desktop to the hosted DC Hub MCP server (https://dchub.cloud/mcp) — no config editing, one click. Works keyless at the free tier (5 calls/day); paste a free or paid API key in the extension settings for higher limits (claim one with the claim_free_key tool or at dchub.cloud/signup).

api_key.title: DC Hub API key (optional)
api_key.description: Optional — the free tier works without one (5 calls/day). Claim a free key at dchub.cloud/signup or by calling the claim_free_key tool, then paste it here so every session keeps your limits.
